emails.subject: Bengaluru UPI payment success down, dragging conversion to 14.4%
emails.body:
Hypothesis: Conversion fell from 15.3% to 14.4%, driven by failed UPI payments in Bengaluru, most likely a payment gateway or bank issue rather than an app release.

Evidence:
- GMV -4.6% = orders -4.5% x average order value -0.1%; orders is the bigger mover, with sessions +0.9% and conversion -5.4%.
- Conversion fell through checkout completion (-5.2%); checkout rate is flat at -0.1%. Payment success went from 94.4% to 86.6%.
- UPI payment success went from 94.0% to 82.6%.
- In Bengaluru, UPI payment success went from 94.0% to 53.1%, and Bengaluru conversion from 15.3% to 12.3%.
- Stores also alerting: HSR Layout, Indiranagar, Koramangala, Whitefield, Jayanagar.

Context: All UPI payments go through one payment gateway partner. A city-level UPI drop usually means a gateway or bank issue, not an app release.

Checks for today:
- Payments team: review the gateway partner's UPI status and error logs for Bengaluru.
- Check with the gateway partner and banks for any Bengaluru incident.
- Engineering: confirm no payment-related release or config change went live.

emails.subject: Delhi GMV -13.9%: fewer items per order, dairy items down
emails.body:
Hypothesis: Delhi GMV fell because average order value dropped on fewer items per order, most likely from dairy stock-outs.

Evidence:
- GMV is Rs 11,41,534 against a usual Rs 13,25,119 (-13.9%). Orders are +0.9%, so average order value (-14.7%) is the bigger mover.
- Average order value is Rs 362 against Rs 424. Items per order is -17.7% (4.28 vs 5.20) and price per item is +3.8%.
- Repeat users, the biggest segment, went from Rs 442 to Rs 377 with share steady (89.3% -> 89.2%). This is a BEHAVIOUR CHANGE, not mix.
- Dairy items are 1,745 today against 3,578 usual (-51.2%). Out-of-stock hours today across stores are 46.
- Stores also alerting: Rohini, Saket, Dwarka.

Context: Dairy is restocked twice a day by one supplier per city. More than 6 out-of-stock hours means a missed delivery.

Checks for today:
- Supply chain: confirm whether the Delhi dairy supplier missed a delivery.
- Store ops: review dairy availability in Rohini, Saket and Dwarka.
- Catalog team: check whether dairy items are hidden or showing as unavailable in the app.

emails.subject: All cities GMV +20.1% vs usual, driven by session surge
emails.body:
Hypothesis: All-cities GMV rose +20.1% on 2026-09-17, driven by a surge in app sessions and a larger share of new users, with no sign of changed user behaviour.

Evidence:
- GMV +20.1% = orders +28.0% x average order value -6.2%. Orders are the bigger mover.
- Orders +28.0% = sessions +36.9% x conversion -6.5%. Sessions are the bigger mover (usual 77,747, today 1,06,457).
- New-user share of conversion mix went from 15.0% to 36.1%, while new-user conversion stayed at 10.9% -> 10.9%.
- New-user average order value stayed flat (Rs 269 -> Rs 271), while their share rose from 10.7% to 27.6%.

Verdict: MIX SHIFT for both conversion and average order value. Each user group behaved normally; more low-spend, low-converting users arrived. No fix is needed beyond confirming why.

Context: Growth runs new-user campaigns without telling analytics. If the new-user share jumps, ask the growth team first.
